Olivia W.: Heads-up — noticed runtime-config.md (docs/runtime/configuration/batching.md) has a confusing sentence about "batch_size defaults to auto". Could a docs owner reword to explain it's a "target batch size" (adapted by the service) and list the fallback behavior? Also the shortlink /runt-config still points to an older page. @Sam P. @Anya K. any chance to swap the shortlink to the canonical page and add an owner frontmatter?
Sam P.: I can PR a wording tweak, will do today. Is there a recommended sentence to use?
Olivia W.: Suggested wording: "The target_batch_size is adaptive; when throughput is low the service may emit smaller batches. To guarantee batching behavior, set target_batch_size explicitly. For very long sequences the runtime may bypass batching and fall back to single-request mode." Thoughts?
Anya K.: That reads clearer to me. +1. Also we should update the shortlink mapping in _data/shortlinks.yml so redirects don't land on the archived page.
LinkBot: link-check: scanned /runt-config -> /docs/runtime/configuration/old-batching.md (redirect). Recommendation: point /runt-config to /docs/runtime/configuration/batching.md. Hits: 198 in last 30d.
Tariq R.: I'm listed as owner for docs/runtime in CODEOWNERS. I can accept owner: eng-runtime in frontmatter if you add it.
Sam P.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — includes reword + frontmatter owner: eng-runtime + shortlink update to /docs/runtime/configuration/batching.md. Requesting a quick review.
Maya L.: Quick check — the example codeblock in the doc shows batch config with `target_batch_size: auto` and a snippet for `batch_window_ms`. Make sure the example still matches runtime behavior for 2.x. @Tariq R. can you confirm?
Tariq R.: Confirmed: runtime 2.1.0 treats `auto` as adaptive and will drop to single-request only when seq_len > 4096 OR when GPU memory pressure is detected. I'll add that exact note to the PR so it's explicit.
Olivia W.: Awesome — leaving an approve once you include Tariq's note. Thanks everyone :tada: 
Sam P.: will add Tariq's sentence in a follow-up commit in the PR today. Tagging @Anya K. for shortlinks review.
Anya K.: Reviewing now, should be a quick merge if tests pass. :thumbsup:
